item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Sleep. Your calendar already has a wind-down built in: relaxation in the evening, then a firm bedtime at quarter past ten. Treat that bedtime as fixed, not a suggestion. Your evening also has a catch-up and a notes session, so finish both early and let your head empty before the day ends. Tonight, set a phone alarm for 9:45 p.m. that says "start winding down," and put the screen away when it rings.
